parts.text: There’s an important catch. The researchers were working with samples from people whose
were already known. Only a small number had Stic, so the results are still uncertain. If the test were offered widely to people without symptoms, very few would be likely to have these patches of

cells. Even a small proportion of false alarms could send many people for unnecessary tests or even surgery.

What it could mean for people at higher risk

BRCA1 and BRCA2 are genes that help
damage to DNA, the genetic instructions in our cells. People who inherit a harmful change in either gene have a higher risk of ovarian cancer. They may be advised to consider surgery to remove their
and fallopian tubes once they have finished having children or if they do not plan to have them. The operation lowers their risk, but it ends their ability to get pregnant without

treatment. If they haven’t yet reached menopause, the sudden drop in hormones after surgery brings it on straight away.

The National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (Nice) advises that
teams can consider regular CA125 testing for some people at high inherited risk who delay or decline surgery. Tu-stroma might one day improve that monitoring. For now, even if the

test picks up no warning signs, that result gives someone no basis to postpone recommended surgery.

A large UK trial found that screening with CA125 picked up more ovarian and fallopian tube cancers at an

stage. Even after years of follow-up, there was no clear evidence that fewer people died from those cancers. With Tu-stroma, researchers still need to find out how often the abnormal cells in the tube lining start growing into
tissue. They also need to work out what to do if the blood test flags a problem but a scan shows nothing. The question a screening trial would
have to answer is whether acting on that result saves lives.

reading.title: 主旨、理解与信息定位
reading.instruction: 阅读原文后回答 5 道选择题：1 道主旨、1 道内容理解、1 道段落细节、2 道信息定位。段落细节题以题干指定段落为准。

questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the overall focus of this article?
options: The physical properties of foods explain why freezing and thawing affect their textures differently.
Managing blood sugar requires understanding which strategies actually reduce glucose spikes.
Evidence about fluoride helps explain the differences between natural and conventional toothpaste.
Blood changes may provide clues to very early processes associated with ovarian cancer.
questions.explanation: 把标题与全文各段的中心内容连起来判断主旨，避免把同一主题下的其他话题当成本文重点。
questions.evidence: This patch, known as serous tubal intraepithelial carcinoma (Stic for short), can be an early step towards this type of ovarian cancer.

questions.prompt: How are the earliest changes discussed usually identified?
options: By a specialist examining tissue under a microscope
By reading an ordinary food label
By asking patients to estimate their height
questions.explanation: 第 2 段提供了作答依据。正确选项用不同说法表达了文中的信息；请比较范围、数量、因果关系与限定词。
questions.evidence: The first changes can be so small that they’re usually found only when a specialist examines the tube under a microscope after surgery.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is explicitly made in paragraph 5?
options: They found higher levels in people with early cancer that had begun growing into nearby tissue.
Ovarian cancer can cause symptoms such as persistent bloating and pain in the tummy or low down between the hips.
Levels were also higher in people with a tiny patch of abnormal cells still confined to the lining of the fallopian tube.
When investigating symptoms, doctors may use a blood test for CA125, a protein whose level can rise when ovarian cancer is present.
